text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To commemorate the brilliance that horse girls have left across countless races, a special video booklet titled "Footprints of Horse Girls" was set to be produced.

text_block_list.name: Interview Team
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, is that right?
So it was just non-stop nerves when you first arrived here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was my very first time in the big city, and there were so many things I wasn't used to!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But that also meant so many people were there to help me out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whenever I was troubled or felt like giving up, there was always someone by my side giving me courage!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All those precious memories are treasures that continue to keep me running to this very day!

text_block_list.name: Interview Team
text_block_list.text: Not even so many obstacles could stop you. And surely, that won't change going forward either.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm the strongest horse girl, Tokai Teio! Giving up was never an option for me from the start!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Besides... those walls were all valuable experiences to make me stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Of course, things going smoothly would've been totally fine too, though. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Even so... if one appears right in front of me, I'll just smash through it and keep moving forward. Because that's the kind of horse girl I am!

text_block_list.name: Interview Team
text_block_list.text: It's well known that you've looked up to Teio-san, but how do you view yourself right now?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, I still feel I have a long way to go!! Teio-san is truly an incredible horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: However... wanting to bring smiles to lots of people and give them courage... I do feel I've gotten closer to that dream!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm not satisfied yet. Because there's still so much more I want to deliver to everyone with my running!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So... I'm going to keep getting stronger! Together with everyone supporting me, and together with all my rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Interview Team
text_block_list.text: Well then, lastly for the photoshoot... could we get a few words of encouragement for all the horse girls striving toward their dreams?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... do your best, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: At first, things don't go smoothly for anyone. But that's totally natural, so there's no need to get discouraged!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sure all the friends, rivals, and Trainers you'll meet from now on will be there to help you out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And, um... I'd be super happy if I could be one of the people who helps you too!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm... let's see. You won't easily find a horse girl as strong as me, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I want you to aim for it! Aim to be the strongest horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Once you think you've gotten stronger, come call out to me! I'll personally take you on♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, I'll probably be your biggest wall to overcome! Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What I want to say... let's see. I'm not really in a place to act all high and mighty, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, in the world of racing there are winners and losers. Losing hurts so much that you might cry or come to a halt...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, you don't want to end things as a loser, right? When that happens, pump yourself up with all you've got and force a smile!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Tell yourself, "I'm not ending things here! I'll run to the ends of the earth until I win!"

text_block_list.name: Interview Team
text_block_list.text: Lastly, everyone line up, please! This will grace the cover of "Footprints of Horse Girls"!

text_block_list.name: Interview Team
text_block_list.text: Here's to all your glory up till now, and to the bright future ahead! Ready, 3, 2, 1!!
